notes.1.272: Otter-payment is gold (the ransom paid for the otter Otr). The presser of the assembly (of battle) and the reddener of the sword are the warrior prince; Grani's heavy load, the riding-metal of Gnita Heath and the Niflungs' treasure are all gold, the hoard carried off on Sigurd's horse Grani. Hlokk is a valkyrie, and her terror is battle. The sense is that the prince gives gold away freely. 1.277 'vigſ er hrutt' is uncertain and may hide a further kenning for the prince.

nodes.text: otter-payment, the prince, to the wise;
often, because of the presser of the assembly,
has Grani's heavy load burst open.
The reddener of the sword wills that it ride,
it is the battle-[lord's] way: flung
and sped off is the Niflungs' treasure.
men, the one bold in Hlokk's terror;
